Container capacity (slots) of the HM Tactical Backpack (all colours). 0 = use the item script default (49). Applies live to backpacks in inventory, on the ground or on zombies. Default: 49.
Weight reduction %% for HM tactical backpacks (all colours). 0 = none, 100 = full. Applies immediately. Default: 95.

Enable this if the tooltip conflicts with weapon-stats mods. This MOD takes over the weapon tooltip to color it (tier color / orange effects / star affixes / golden numbers); that takeover is structurally mutually exclusive with other takeover-style mods. When enabled, this MOD no longer takes over and tooltips return to vanilla style (tier and affix text still shown, just uncolored). Default: off.

Zombies dying inside Willowbrook have this chance to additionally drop one easter-egg toy: Meow Laser Gun / Seven-Treasure Hunt / Salty Fish Greatsword / the Journey-to-the-West set (Ruyi Jingu Bang, Nine-Toothed Rake, Demon-Subduing Staff, Tang Monk's Kasaya). 0.2 = 1 in 500 (default), 1 = 1%%. Set 0 to disable. Nested under the legendary master switch (option 1) - master off means no easter eggs either. Default: 0.2.

Master switch for mod clothing and bags. When off, Willowbrook zombies no longer wear the mod tactical gear (vest/drop-leg rig/backpack/boots/cap-helmet), and the mod bag capacity & weight-reduction settings are disabled too (falls back to item script values). Gear already spawned is unaffected. Default: on.

How strongly legendary melee weapons appear in containers inside Willowbrook. 0 = off, 100 = same as the old behaviour, in-between values scale the chance proportionally (e.g. 50 = half). Firearms in containers are still controlled by "4 Mod firearms & attachments". Requires re-entering the save (container contents are generated at map load). Default: 0 (off).

Master switch for effects/affixes/reforge/peak - all together. When on, effect weapons carry their unique effects and affixes; when off, all weapon effects are disabled - effect weapons become plain vanilla-stat weapons, and their tooltip descriptions are hidden too. Default: off.

Master switch for firearms and attachments (QBZ192 / NP4292G / Type 97-1 shotgun / West2Asnape rifle + suppressors). When off, gun rooms, containers and zombie corpses inside Willowbrook no longer spawn firearms or attachments. Guns already spawned are unaffected. Default: off.

Master switch for the 7 legendary melee weapons (Hanjian / Maiduo spear / Epoxy stick / Ashbringer / Arathor / Doomhammer / Silverhand). When off, they no longer spawn anywhere: special rooms, containers or zombie corpses, and the easter-egg toys (1.3) are disabled too. Weapons already spawned are unaffected and stay usable/repairable. Default: on.

Volume of the legendary drop sound played when a special weapon or firearm lands on the ground (Uber-tier weapons use their own dedicated sound). 0 = completely silent (same as off). Drag the slider to adjust; the "Preview" button on the right plays the sound at the current volume (hold Shift and click to preview the Uber-tier sound). Client-side playback only; the drop itself is unaffected. Default: 10.
Legendary weapon spawns in special map rooms (Ashbringer / Maiduo spear / epoxy stick / Hanjian rooms). Only affects newly generated containers. Default: on.

If enabled, new players automatically learn all mod forge recipes (Tangdao/Liuyedao/Miaodao/HanHuanshoudao/Taishanbaohuan/Yuchangjian/Modao/Zilongchangqiang/Mashuo/Daxialongque). If disabled, the recipes cannot be learned or crafted. Default: on.

Local gunshot volume percentage while the NP4292G suppressor is attached. 100 = original suppressed volume, 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - the suppressed SoundRadius stays as-is. Preview plays the suppressed pistol shot. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the NP4292G pistol. 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched. When a suppressor is attached, 4.4 takes over (not stacked). Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage while the QBZ192 suppressor is attached. 100 = original suppressed volume, 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - the suppressed SoundRadius stays as-is. Preview plays the suppressed QBZ192 shot. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the QBZ192 assault rifle. 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched, so zombie attraction is exactly as before. When a suppressor is attached, 4.2 takes over (not stacked). The "Preview" button plays it at the slider's current volume. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage while the Type 97-1 suppressor is attached. 100 = original suppressed volume, 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - the suppressed SoundRadius stays as-is. Preview plays the suppressed shotgun blast. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the Type 97-1 pump shotgun (the loudest of the four). 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched. When a suppressor is attached, 4.6 takes over (not stacked). Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage while the marksman rifle suppressor is attached. 100 = original suppressed volume, 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - the suppressed SoundRadius stays as-is. Preview plays the suppressed marksman rifle shot. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the West2Asnape marksman rifle. 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched. When a suppressor is attached, 4.8 takes over (not stacked). Default: 100.

Plays this row's sound at the volume currently set on the slider (reads the slider, not the saved value).

Container capacity (slots) of the HM Tactical Backpack (all colours). 0 = use the item script default (49). Applies live to backpacks in inventory, on the ground or on zombies. Default: 49.
Weight reduction %% for HM tactical backpacks (all colours). 0 = none, 100 = full. Applies immediately. Default: 95.

Enable this if the tooltip conflicts with weapon-stats mods. This MOD takes over the weapon tooltip to color it (tier color / orange effects / star affixes / golden numbers); that takeover is structurally mutually exclusive with other takeover-style mods. When enabled, this MOD no longer takes over and tooltips return to vanilla style (tier and affix text still shown, just uncolored). Default: off.

Zombies dying inside Willowbrook have this chance to additionally drop one easter-egg toy: Meow Laser Gun / Seven-Treasure Hunt / Salty Fish Greatsword / the Journey-to-the-West set (Ruyi Jingu Bang, Nine-Toothed Rake, Demon-Subduing Staff, Tang Monk's Kasaya). 0.2 = 1 in 500 (default), 1 = 1%%. Set 0 to disable. Nested under the legendary master switch (option 1) - master off means no easter eggs either. Default: 0.2.

Master switch for mod clothing and bags. When off, Willowbrook zombies no longer wear the mod tactical gear (vest/drop-leg rig/backpack/boots/cap-helmet), and the mod bag capacity & weight-reduction settings are disabled too (falls back to item script values). Gear already spawned is unaffected. Default: on.

How strongly legendary melee weapons appear in containers inside Willowbrook. 0 = off, 100 = same as the old behaviour, in-between values scale the chance proportionally (e.g. 50 = half). Firearms in containers are still controlled by "4 Mod firearms & attachments". Requires re-entering the save (container contents are generated at map load). Default: 0 (off).

Master switch for effects/affixes/reforge/peak - all together. When on, effect weapons carry their unique effects and affixes; when off, all weapon effects are disabled - effect weapons become plain vanilla-stat weapons, and their tooltip descriptions are hidden too. Default: off.

Master switch for firearms and attachments (QBZ192 / NP4292G / Type 97-1 shotgun / West2Asnape rifle + suppressors). When off, gun rooms, containers and zombie corpses inside Willowbrook no longer spawn firearms or attachments. Guns already spawned are unaffected. Default: off.

Master switch for the 7 legendary melee weapons (Hanjian / Maiduo spear / Epoxy stick / Ashbringer / Arathor / Doomhammer / Silverhand). When off, they no longer spawn anywhere: special rooms, containers or zombie corpses, and the easter-egg toys (1.3) are disabled too. Weapons already spawned are unaffected and stay usable/repairable. Default: on.

Volume of the legendary drop sound played when a special weapon or firearm lands on the ground (Uber-tier weapons use their own dedicated sound). 0 = completely silent (same as off). Drag the slider to adjust; the "Preview" button on the right plays the sound at the current volume (hold Shift and click to preview the Uber-tier sound). Client-side playback only; the drop itself is unaffected. Default: 10.
Legendary weapon spawns in special map rooms (Ashbringer / Maiduo spear / epoxy stick / Hanjian rooms). Only affects newly generated containers. Default: on.

If enabled, new players automatically learn all mod forge recipes (Tangdao/Liuyedao/Miaodao/HanHuanshoudao/Taishanbaohuan/Yuchangjian/Modao/Zilongchangqiang/Mashuo/Daxialongque). If disabled, the recipes cannot be learned or crafted. Default: on.

Local gunshot volume percentage while the NP4292G suppressor is attached. 100 = original suppressed volume, 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - the suppressed SoundRadius stays as-is. Preview plays the suppressed pistol shot. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the NP4292G pistol. 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched. When a suppressor is attached, 4.4 takes over (not stacked). Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage while the QBZ192 suppressor is attached. 100 = original suppressed volume, 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - the suppressed SoundRadius stays as-is. Preview plays the suppressed QBZ192 shot. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the QBZ192 assault rifle. 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched, so zombie attraction is exactly as before. When a suppressor is attached, 4.2 takes over (not stacked). The "Preview" button plays it at the slider's current volume. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage while the Type 97-1 suppressor is attached. 100 = original suppressed volume, 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - the suppressed SoundRadius stays as-is. Preview plays the suppressed shotgun blast. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the Type 97-1 pump shotgun (the loudest of the four). 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched. When a suppressor is attached, 4.6 takes over (not stacked). Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage while the marksman rifle suppressor is attached. 100 = original suppressed volume, 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - the suppressed SoundRadius stays as-is. Preview plays the suppressed marksman rifle shot. Default: 100.

Local gunshot volume percentage for the West2Asnape marksman rifle. 100 = the weapon script's original volume (default, untouched), 0 = silent. Only the volume you hear changes - SoundRadius is never touched. When a suppressor is attached, 4.8 takes over (not stacked). Default: 100.
